why: Advice 2 gets the math right and makes the right call on a low-risk hire: even with no new sales, profit only falls to about ¥640k a month. It also points to the real open question, whether the work being turned down is limited by the owner's time or by a shortage of photographers. Advice 1 has sharper tests and thresholds, but it changes the job into admin plus arranging outside photographers, which makes the hire harder to fill, and its downside figure is shakier.
